description: This Java source file defines an immutable class that provides an ExceptionHandler for the root route in an Akka HTTP server setup. The handler maps specific exceptions (DittoRuntimeException, JsonRuntimeException, and CompletionException with specific causes) to HTTP responses, and includes logging functionality for exceptions.

classes.name: RootRouteExceptionHandler
classes.description: Provides an Akka HTTP ExceptionHandler for the root route, mapping exceptions to HTTP responses with logging.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create an ExceptionHandler for the root route, configuring mappings for specific exception types and internal server errors.

methods.name: handleDittoRuntimeException
methods.description: Handles DittoRuntimeException by logging and converting it to an HTTP response.

methods.description: Logs details about a DittoRuntimeException, including correlation ID and exception type.

methods.description: Logs unexpected exceptions and returns an INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR response.
